notes: The vocative ye is placed on כֹּל, the nominal head of the vocative phrase, rather than on יְהוּדָה; rule 36 permits either and the unit note records the competing reading.
enter in treated as a phrasal verb under rule 44 so that at renders בְּ, avoiding an added word.
Both demonstrative phrases (this word, these gates) leave the noun's article and the agreement article unrepresented, since the demonstrative morpheme licenses the written determiner (rules 29, 41).
